The suggestion provides: (1) clear action-oriented summary, (2) explanation of purpose and domain context, (3) indication of parameters and response content, (4) authentication requirements, and (5) guidance for AI agents on when to use this operation. data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve claim file details and information
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves detailed information about an opened claim file (dosya). This operation accepts multiple filter and query parameters to specify which claim details to retrieve. Returns comprehensive claim file information including status, dates, amounts, and associated metadata. Requires basic authentication with provided credentials. Use this operation to fetch specific claim file details when you need to access or review claim information.
